purpose: Teach: 農政/国民党/生育/深層/重度/照射/同和/音程

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、農政改革に絡む不正を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police handle cases involving agricultural policy corruption, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful cadence. Slightly formal register—he's thinking aloud, testing understanding. Gentle rise at the end, genuinely seeking confirmation, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、台湾国民党関連の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police also manage security related to the KMT, correct?
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Affirming without elaborating. A short nod in the voice. He's confirming procedure calmly, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、児童の生育環境調査を、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: The police conduct investigations into children's living environments in these cases, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Careful articulation—this is delicate ground. Quiet respect in the pacing. Seeking validation without pushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、海洋深層での密漁事件もご捜査ですね
lines.en: The police also investigate illegal fishing operations in deep ocean waters, I understand?
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. He's listing facts with quiet confidence. No rush. Each phrase sits firmly before the next one begins.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、重度の虐待事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police handle severe abuse cases like this one, don't they?
lines.style: Softer onset. The words land carefully—he knows this is heavy. Slight hesitation before the word 'severe,' showing he feels the weight of it. Quieter close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、放射線照射事故の捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police also investigate radiation exposure accidents, correct?
lines.style: Clinical, procedural tone. He's moving through a checklist methodically. No emotion in the delivery, just clear sequence. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、同和地区での差別事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police handle discrimination cases in Dowa districts as well, don't they?
lines.style: Slightly slower delivery. Respectful but firm—this matters. He knows the sensitivity. Slight weight on 'discrimination.' Not apologetic, but grounded.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の声紋音程分析もされますね
lines.en: The police conduct voice frequency analysis on suspects too, I gather?
lines.style: Intimate, conversational draw. He's moved closer—more personal inquiry now. Softer attack. Slightly tentative, as if asking about something he's genuinely curious to know Takeda confirm.
